items.title: Apple同步推出macOS與iOS/iPadOS 27.2版，修補286個漏洞
items.summary: Apple於10月26日同步推出macOS Golden Gate與iOS/iPadOS的27.2版，兩份安全公告分別列出263個與163個漏洞，合計426個，由於約有140個漏洞同時影響兩組系統，扣除重複項目後，涉及的獨立漏洞共286個。

items.title: Cloudflare AI服務快取出錯，155次GLM-5.3回答混入他人資料
items.summary: Cloudflare公布旗下AI服務Workers AI的資料外洩調查結果，指出8月27日至9月9日期間，GLM-5.3模型共有155次回應混入其他客戶的資料。問題發生在處理特別長的輸入內容時，Cloudflare已於9月9日完成修復，確認其他Workers AI模型未受影響，也沒有發現有人蓄意利用漏洞的證據。

items.title: Amazon修訂軟體工程師職務指引，強調AI時代應重成果而非Token用量
items.summary: Amazon周二（10/27）公布新版軟體開發工程師（SDE）職務指引，重新界定AI時代工程師的角色與工作要求。Amazon強調，儘管AI正快速改變軟體開發方式，衡量工程師表現仍應以實際工作成果為主，而非AI工具採用率、Token用量或程式碼數量。

items.title: 美國NIST發布PQC遷移路線圖，RSA、ECDSA等傳統公鑰演算法2030年後逐步退場，2035年後禁用
items.summary: 隨著後量子密碼學（PQC）標準逐步確立，既有系統升級與傳統公鑰演算法汰換，成為政府與企業面臨的重要課題。

items.title: Mozilla發布Firefox大改版159，修補逾100個高風險漏洞
items.summary: Mozilla基金會於10月27日正式推出Firefox 159大改版，揭露並修補167個資安漏洞，其中108個被評為高風險，影響範圍涵蓋JavaScript引擎、DOM、WebRTC、網路通訊，以及圖形處理等元件。此次修補的漏洞類型包括同源政策繞過、沙箱逃逸、權限提升、資訊洩露及記憶體安全問題。

items.title: Google發布Chrome 156更新，修補逾50個資安漏洞
items.summary: 10月27日Google發布穩定通道的Chrome更新，一共修補52個資安漏洞，從嚴重程度來看，4個為重大等級，46個為高風險等級。

items.title: feat(memory-lancedb): report health and serve search through the memo…
items.summary: feat(memory-lancedb): report health and serve search through the memory provider runtime (#165756) * feat(memory-lancedb): serve host memory status, search and get through the provider runtime Register a provider-neutral providerRuntime so a memory-lancedb slot owner reports its real health and lets operator and owner-private callers search and fetch its stored memories. Tools, auto-recall and auto-capture keep their existing paths. Refs #158822 * test(memory-lancedb): avoid an unbound method reference in the registration assertion * fix(memory-lancedb): keep embedding failure detail out of provider health Health reaches callers that cannot read stored memories, and an embedding credential failure can name the auth store and agent directory. Report a fixed public-safe summary and send the detail to the Gateway log. * fix(memory-lancedb): recheck caller authority after store preparation Provider search and get checked authority before calling the store, which then awaits table initialization or a handle refresh. A grant revoked during that await still reached the query. The store now runs the caller's guard once the table is prepared and synchronously before dispatch. The regression test revokes an owner-private audience inside the real table's preparation call and asserts no vector search or query is dispatched. The health redaction test now mirrors the host's missing-provider-auth message. * fix(memory-lancedb): stop retaining embedding error text for health Health only needs to know that the last embedding request failed and when. Keep the timestamp and drop the message, which can name host paths. The revocation test now asserts its table spies observe a real read first. Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01DdpRhmxdv32zynXs5LXh9Q * docs(memory-lancedb): state Gateway support and the Control UI search gap The provider answers memory.status, memory.search version 2 and memory.get. The Control UI Memories tab still sends the unversioned search, so say it cannot search LanceDB memories yet instead of implying it can. The revocation test now derives the lapse from the preparation spy's call count, which removes the unbound method references the type-aware lint rejects. Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01DdpRhmxdv32zynXs5LXh9Q * test(memory-lancedb): tighten provider regression fixtures --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
